out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hot water at the handwashing sink in the servery is not functioning. Only cold water available.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The low temp dishwasher in the servery closest to the wall was not observed to be sanitizing equipment.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. STAFF TO USE THE OTHER DW UNTIL THE UNIT IS SERVICED.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: bbq chicken in hot holding box at 114°F- 30 min in unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. REHEATED TO 171°F.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility. A can of flying pest spray was observed on the 3 comp sink area.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS INFORMED CFM PEST CONTROL MUST BE DONE BY CERTIFIED APPLICATOR.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: two packages of whole turkeys were observed at the 3 comp sink. CFM stated 1 hour outside.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CFM RELOCATED FOODS TO WIC.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control fruit flies in the memory care kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The low temp dishwasher in the servery (closest to wall) following is not operating properly.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip or temperature dish plate available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. SUNRISE AT SILAS BURKE HOUSE (Inspection Date: 09/23/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: exterior of all refrigeration units.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed areas of peeling on several ceiling tiles in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. MAIN SERVERY HAS 2 DISHWASHERS. THE ONE THAT IS WORKING (Left) WILL BE USED UNTIL OTHER MACHINE IS SERVICED.

violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: deli slicer and can opener in main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. ITEMS WERE REMOVED FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING.

violations.observation: CONTAINER USED TO HOLD ICE SCOOP IN FIRST FLOOR SERVERY WAS NOT OBSERVED CLEAN AND CONTAINER USED TO HOLD CLEAN UTENSILS IN THE OTHER SERVERY WAS NOT OBSERVED CLEAN.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours for iced tea dispensers and consumer self-service utensils such as tongs, scoops, or ladles. REMOVED FOR CLEANING.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: REFRIGERATED PREP UNIT IN FIRST FLOOR SERVERY (SHRIMP 48°F, TUNA SALAD 44°F, CHICKEN SALAD 44°F, )
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. FOOD ITEMS WERE RELOCATED TO SINGLE DOOR FRIDGE.
